convergence: projected gradient <= 2e-5 AND relative objective change <= 1e-7
classification_precedence: CONVERGING_BUT_BUDGET_LIMITED if convergence first occurs in 25..96 and no meaningful normalized objective increase occurs
REGISTRATION_PROTOTYPE_OSCILLATION if a meaningful normalized objective increase occurs in the last 8 blocks together with nonzero assignment changes in at least 3 of those blocks
STILL_DESCENDING_STRONGLY if no convergence by 96 and normalized decrease across the late window exceeds 1e-5
OBJECTIVE_PLATEAU_GRADIENT_NOT_CONVERGED if no convergence, every late relative change is <=1e-7, and the late median gradient exceeds 2e-5
bank_stability_gate: every default-step start converges by 96; no meaningful normalized objective increase; all values finite
common_budget_rule: smallest member of {48,64,96} greater than or equal to the maximum first-convergence iteration across both starts of the exact cell and all frozen bank tasks
initial_step_candidate_rule: A larger candidate must converge all exact+bank starts, reduce the common milestone budget relative to 1.0, have no meaningful objective increase, and have total changed assignments no greater than 1.0. Ties choose the smaller initial candidate.
